description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008. Notification Under Section 3 (2)
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008 and contains detailed regulatory provisions including tax exemptions (Corporate Income Tax, VAT), Ports and Airports Development Levy exemptions, and specific legal conditions for enterprises operating within a designated textile manufacturing zone. It establishes a regulatory framework and compliance requirements for strategic development projects, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
